accurate: Economic absorption was tested with sales, recurring profit, persistent costs and parent adjusted profit rather than station count, plasma collection or nameplate capacity.
FY2023 cash improvement was not extrapolated and group cash, NCI attribution and parent access were kept separate.
Quality and regulatory treatment required an observed adverse carrier; absent adverse disclosure remained neutral rather than favorable.
All five preoutcome treatment directions survived the FY2024 settlement.
understated: The base scenario understated the magnitude of FY2024 revenue, parent adjusted profit and recurring-margin absorption.
The scenario narrative underweighted the joint state of favorable operating absorption with negative nonstructural group cash and open parent scope.
prohibited_inference_avoided: No parent owner cash was inferred from consolidated cash or parent liquidity.
No permanent moat was inferred from strong profit or 100 percent self-inspection and batch-release pass rates.
Local unknown Chengdu Rongsheng post-capex cash, net parent support and R&D measurement did not cancel favorable absorption.

material_treatment_snapshot.boundary: Strong absorption reinforces operating and normal-earnings confidence. Negative single-year nonstructural group cash with open parent scope remains conditional only and does not propagate to permanent loss or valuation. Quality neutral preserves prior treatment.

postoutcome_investor_judgment.management_execution: Positive operating credit is reinforced by sales and recurring-profit absorption, but no permanent management-quality conclusion is authorized.
postoutcome_investor_judgment.normal_earnings: Raise is reinforced; the single-year FY2024 margin is not capitalized as permanent.
postoutcome_investor_judgment.owner_cash: Count conditionally until Chengdu Rongsheng post-capex cash, required retention, non-financing parent upstream receipts and net parent support close.
postoutcome_investor_judgment.permanent_loss: Maintain the quality, licence, demand, working-capital and capital-allocation constraints; no disclosed FY2024 carrier justifies tightening or relaxation.

future_training_feedback.specific_error: The preoutcome classes separated operating absorption from owner cash correctly, but the reader-facing scenarios coupled favorable absorption too closely to cash improvement and did not explicitly foreground favorable absorption plus negative nonstructural group cash plus open parent scope.
future_training_feedback.economic_impact: A future forecaster could correctly recognize higher normal earnings yet overcount parent owner cash or mistakenly propagate a one-year cash conversion shortfall into permanent loss and valuation.
missing_facts_to_target: working-capital cash bridge for inventory, receivables and payables
material subsidiary post-capex cash and required retention
actual non-financing parent upstream receipts and net parent support
prohibited_assumptions: Favorable profit absorption implies parent distributable cash.
A single-year nonstructural negative group cash proxy implies permanent loss or valuation DOWN.
Open subsidiary post-capex or parent-support fields cancel an otherwise complete operating-absorption result.
future_training_feedback.executable_research_behavior: For a future retired-case training cycle, freeze operating absorption and owner-cash conversion as orthogonal scenario axes and require an explicit joint branch for ABSORPTION_FAVORABLE plus OWNER_CASH_GROUP_NONSTRUCTURAL_SCOPE_OPEN, supported by both a recurring-profit bridge and a working-capital/parent-cash bridge.
future_training_feedback.acceptance_criteria: The joint branch preserves management POSITIVE_CREDIT, normal earnings RAISE and valuation UP, keeps owner cash COUNT_CONDITIONALLY, leaves permanent loss MAINTAIN_CONSTRAINT absent a direct carrier, and names the exact facts that would upgrade or worsen the cash axis.

holdout_conclusion.METHOD_UTILITY_INTERPRETATION: Single-arm holdout outcome review has no same-cutoff comparison and therefore neither establishes NO_MATERIAL_UTILITY nor validates transfer.
